title: Moroccan Fish Stew
description: A flavorful and nutritious fish stew inspired by Moroccan cuisine, made with fresh fish, light broth, and aromatic spices. Gluten-free and perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the light broth in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the Moroccan spice blend, onion, garlic, carrots, and potatoes to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the fish fillets to the pot and cook for an additional 8-10 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
